## Overview

This repository establishes a complete, machine-checked ten-theorem theory of **Early State Exclusion (ESE)** in one-dimensional $XX$ quantum spin chains realizing **Perfect State Transfer (PST)**—resolving **Conjecture 4.1** of Escobar, Garcia, and Minenkova ([arXiv:2507.18767v1](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.18767)) in full generality and mapping the exact structural, geometric, and topological frontier across all chain lengths $N$:

| Pillar | Headline Result | Epistemic Tag | Lean 4.35.0 / Verification Artifact |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **I (Thms. 1–3)** | Complete $4\times 4, 5\times 5, 6\times 6$ dichotomies & universal even-chain converse ($\forall 2n$) | `[LEAN-6K]` | `dichotomy_{4x4,5x5,6x6}`, `even_hasESE_of_min_ge_three` |
| **II (Thm. 4)** | Complete resolution of **Conjecture 4.1** ($7\times 7$, reduced & arbitrary real-scaled unreduced) | `[LEAN-6K]` | `conjecture_4_1_7x7`, `conjecture_4_1_7x7_unreduced` |
| **III (Thm. 5)** | Sharp even rupture at $N_{\mathrm{crit}}^{\mathrm{even}} = 8$ ($\forall m \ge 1$) | `[LEAN-6K]` | `even_rupture_8x8` |
| **III (Thm. 6)** | **Critical $9\times 9$ No-ESE Theorem**: $A_9(1,b,c,d;t)>0$ on $[0,\pi)$ for ALL $1<b<c<d$ | `[LEAN-6K]` | `odd_critical_9x9_no_ESE` (+ 19 Bernstein certs) |
| **III (Thm. 7)** | Sharp odd rupture at $N_{\mathrm{crit}}^{\mathrm{odd}} = 11$: exact threshold $m \ge 6 \iff M^* = 12$ | `[LEAN-6K]` | `odd_rupture_11x11_threshold` |
| **IV (Thm. 8)** | Universal $(R,r)$ Krawtchouk-core vs. spectral-cluster phase transition at $N_{\mathrm{crit}}(R) = 3R + 2$ | `[LEAN-6K]` | `universal_phase_transition_3R_plus_2` |
| **V (Thm. 9)** | First infinite non-symmetric staggered-field $5\times 5$ complex ESE family $J_{a,b}$ ($A(\pi/3)=0\in\C$) | `[LEAN-6K]` | `theorem_9_nonsymmetric_family` |
| **VI (Thm. 10)** | Exact QGTL metric $g_{tt}=b_0^2$, Mandelstam–Tamm QSL $\tau\ge\pi/(2|b_0|)$, & ESE–ETE duality | `[LEAN-6K]` | `mandelstam_tamm_ese_bound`, `ese_ete_duality` |
| **Empirical** | Pre-registered 4-arm QRNG static-disorder study ($K=30$ seeds, Holm FWER): H1–H3 SIG, **H4 honest null** | `[EMPIRICAL]` | `PREREGISTRATION.md`, `DEVIATIONS.md`, `results/qgtl_qrng_analysis.json` |

- **Preprint PDF:** [dist/Donahue_2026_spectral_eclipse_frontier.pdf](dist/Donahue_2026_spectral_eclipse_frontier.pdf)
- **Standalone arXiv Source Tarball:** [dist/arxiv_submission.tar.gz](dist/arxiv_submission.tar.gz)

## Quickstart

```bash
# 1. Verify all 10 Lean 4.35.0 theorems, Palomar Challenge/Solution bridge, Batteries linter & 572-theorem axiom audit
cd lean && lake exe cache get && lake build SpectralEclipse Challenge Solution VerifyAxioms
lake env lean VerifyAxioms.lean
lake exe runLinter SpectralEclipse Solution
cd ..

# 2. Install pinned Python environment + editable package and run the full verification ladder (22 tests + 1,000-case Hypothesis)
python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
python -m pip install --no-deps -e .
python -m pytest -v tests/

# 3. Run the independent exact rational Sturm + 80-digit mpmath oracle & example quickstart
python reference/exact_oracle.py
python examples/quickstart.py

# 4. Run 100% B13 mutation audit, live citation/retraction audit, axiom-sync, manifest & timestamp checks
python scripts/mutation_audit.py
python scripts/check_citations.py
python scripts/check_readme_axioms.py --require-exhaustive
python scripts/generate_manifest.py --verify
python scripts/stamp_timestamps.py --verify
```

See [justfile](justfile) and [REPLICATION.md](REPLICATION.md) for single-command recipes covering all 8 polyglot/quantum engines (AVX2 NASM Assembly, ISO C11, ISO C++20, Safe Rust, Zig exact $\mathbb{Q}$, Eshkol v1.3.6 native AD, Moonlab 32-dim 5-qubit WASM, and vendored QGTL/QRNG).

## Usage

```python
import math
from spectral_eclipse import (
    FLOAT64_CANCELLATION_MARGIN,
    detect_real_ese,
    persymmetric_weights,
    reconstruct_persymmetric_jacobi,
    return_amplitude,
    target_amplitude,
)

# Example 1: Conjecture 4.1 ESE witness {0, +-3, +-4, +-5}
chain7 = reconstruct_persymmetric_jacobi([-5, -4, -3, 0, 3, 4, 5])
has_ese, tau = detect_real_ese(chain7)
print(f"7x7 ESE={has_ese}, tau={tau:.6f}, QSL={chain7.qsl_bound:.6f}, b0^2={chain7.b0_sq:.4f}")

# Example 2: Theorem 9 staggered-field non-symmetric J_{1,4} {0, 1, 4, 9, 10}
j14 = reconstruct_persymmetric_jacobi([0, 1, 4, 9, 10])
print(f"J14 |A(pi/3)| = {abs(return_amplitude(j14, math.pi / 3)):.3e}")
print(f"J14 |T(pi)|   = {abs(target_amplitude(j14, math.pi)):.12f}")
print(f"B20 guard     = {FLOAT64_CANCELLATION_MARGIN:.1e}")

# Example 3: Boundary validation (non-strictly-increasing spectra raise ValueError)
try:
    persymmetric_weights([0.0, 1.0, 1.0, 2.0])
except ValueError as exc:
    print(f"Rejected invalid spectrum: {exc}")
```

## Claims Registry & Falsification Protocol (CLAIMS.md)

# Claims Registry & Explicit Falsification Protocol

Every scientific, mathematical, and empirical claim in **The Spectral Eclipse Frontier** (`v1.1.0`) is enumerated below with its exact verification tag, executable verification command, and concrete falsification criterion (**What Would Prove Us Wrong**).

## Verification Tag Taxonomy

- **`[LEAN-6K]`**: Machine-checked inside the Lean 4.35.0 kernel (`autoImplicit = false`, zero `sorry`, zero custom axioms, strictly `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]`, zero Batteries `runLinter` errors), backed by isolated Mathlib-only `Challenge.lean` / `Solution.lean` targets replayed across six independent checker runs (`lake comparator --config comparator.json --paranoid`) plus a live `sorry`-tamper negative comparator CI gate.
- **`[EXACT-COMP]`**: Verified by exact rational arithmetic over $\mathbb{Q}$ (`reference/exact_oracle.py` SymPy square-free Sturm root isolation, `engines/zig` arbitrary-precision rational Hochstadt engine) or exhaustive deterministic integer scans (`engines/rust`, `engines/cpp`).
- **`[EMPIRICAL]`**: Pre-registered computational experiment locked in `PREREGISTRATION.md` (commit `1dac632`) before data generation (with post-hoc optimizer bug-fix Deviation #1 logged in `DEVIATIONS.md`), analyzed via paired exact permutation tests and Holm–Bonferroni FWER control.

## Master Claims Table (C1–C12)

| Claim | Statement | Tag | Primary Evidence / Artifact | Falsification Condition (What Would Prove Us Wrong) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **C1** | Complete $4\times 4$ dichotomy: $\neg\mathrm{ESE}\iff p=1$ | `[LEAN-6K]` | `SpectralEclipse.dichotomy_4x4` (`target_theorem_1_4x4`) | A reduced $4\times 4$ PST chain with $p=1$ exhibiting $A_4(\tau)=0$ on $(0,\pi)$, or $p\ge 3$ remaining strictly positive on $(0,\pi)$. |
| **C2** | Complete $5\times 5$ dichotomy: $\neg\mathrm{ESE}\iff y=1$ | `[LEAN-6K]` | `SpectralEclipse.dichotomy_5x5` (`target_theorem_2_5x5`) | A reduced $5\times 5$ symmetric PST chain violating $\neg\mathrm{ESE}\iff y=1$. |
| **C3** | Complete $6\times 6$ even dichotomy: $\neg\mathrm{ESE}\iff p=1$ + universal even converse | `[LEAN-6K]` | `SpectralEclipse.dichotomy_6x6`, `even_hasESE_of_min_ge_three` | Any $6\times 6$ chain with $p=1$ crossing zero on $(0,\pi)$, or any even $2n$ chain with $p_1\ge 3$ avoiding zero. |
| **C4** | Complete resolution of **Conjecture 4.1** (`arXiv:2507.18767v1`), reduced & unreduced real-scaled | `[LEAN-6K]` | `conjecture_4_1_7x7`, `conjecture_4_1_7x7_unreduced` | Any $7\times 7$ symmetric PST chain with $x\mid y, x\mid z$ having ESE, or with $x\nmid y$ or $x\nmid z$ avoiding ESE. |
| **C5** | Sharp even rupture at $N_{\mathrm{crit}}^{\mathrm{even}} = 8$ ($\forall m \ge 1$) | `[LEAN-6K]` | `SpectralEclipse.even_rupture_8x8` | Any integer $m\ge 1$ for which $A_8(1, 4m+3, 4m+5, 4m+7; 2\pi/(4m+5)) \ge 0$. |
| **C6** | **Critical $9\times 9$ No-ESE Theorem**: $\forall 1<b<c<d$ alternating parity, $A_9(1,b,c,d;t)>0$ on $[0,\pi)$ | `[LEAN-6K]` | `SpectralEclipse.odd_critical_9x9_no_ESE` + 19 Bernstein certs | Any alternating-parity triple $(b,c,d)$ with $1<b<c<d$ and any $t\in[0,\pi)$ with $A_9(1,b,c,d;t)\le 0$. |
| **C7** | Sharp odd rupture at $N_{\mathrm{crit}}^{\mathrm{odd}} = 11$: $S(m)$ has ESE $\iff m\ge 6$ ($M^*=12$) | `[LEAN-6K]` | `SpectralEclipse.odd_rupture_11x11_threshold` | Any $m\in\{1..5\}$ crossing zero on $(0,\pi)$ or any $m\ge 6$ remaining nonnegative on $(0,\pi)$. |
| **C8** | Universal $(R,r)$ phase transition at $r_{\mathrm{crit}}(R)=R+1$, $N_{\mathrm{crit}}(R)=3R+2$ | `[LEAN-6K]` | `universal_phase_transition_3R_plus_2`, `cluster_self_gap_sum` | Failure of $\Phi(R,r,M)$ to vanish for $r<R$, stabilize at $2^{-(R-1)}$ for $r=R$, or diverge for $r\ge R+1$. |
| **C9** | Infinite non-symmetric staggered-field $5\times 5$ complex ESE family $J_{a,b}$ | `[LEAN-6K]` | `theorem_9_nonsymmetric_family` | Any odd $a$ ($3\nmid a$) and $b=a+6k+3$ where $J_{a,b}$ fails persymmetry, PST $\psi_4(\pi)=1$, or complex ESE $\psi_0(\pi/3)=0\in\mathbb{C}$. |
| **C10** | Exact QGTL metric $g_{tt}=b_0^2$, Mandelstam–Tamm QSL $\tau\ge\pi/(2|b_0|)$, & ESE–ETE duality | `[LEAN-6K]` | `jacobi_energy_variance_eq_b0_sq`, `mandelstam_tamm_ese_bound`, `ese_ete_duality` | Any real Jacobi chain with $\mathrm{Var}_{e_0}(J)\ne b_0^2$, any ESE time $\tau < \pi/(2|b_0|)$, or any PST chain breaking $|\psi_{N-1}(T_0-t)|=|\psi_0(t)|$. |
| **C11** | Finite-$M$ critical thresholds $M^*(4)=30$ ($N=14$), $M^*(5)=78$ ($N=17$) | `[EXACT-COMP]` | `engines/rust/src/main.rs`, `engines/cpp/se_propagator.cpp` | Exact Sturm root count disagreeing with $m=15$ ($N=14$) or $m=39$ ($N=17$). |
| **C12** | Pre-registered QRNG static-disorder study: H1–H3 significant ($p_{\mathrm{Holm}}=0.0004$), H4 clean null ($p_{\mathrm{Holm}}=0.9855$) | `[EMPIRICAL]` | `PREREGISTRATION.md`, `DEVIATIONS.md`, `results/qgtl_qrng_analysis.json` | Independent re-execution of `engines/qgtl_qrng/se_qgtl_qrng` + `scripts/analyze_qrng_study.py` yielding contradictory statistics or contradicting Holm FWER verdicts. |

## Explicit Falsification Protocol (How to Attack This Repo)

1. **Formal Proof Attack:** Inspect `lean/Challenge.lean` (290 lines, Mathlib-only) line by line to confirm definitions match textbook Jacobi matrices, Schrödinger evolution, and Hochstadt amplitudes; then run `cd lean && lake comparator --config comparator.json --paranoid`, `lake env lean VerifyAxioms.lean`, and `lake exe runLinter SpectralEclipse Solution`.
2. **Definition-Fidelity & Tamper Attack:** Inspect `lean/SpectralEclipse/NonVacuity.lean` (18 witnesses) and `lean/SpectralEclipse/AdversarialTests.lean` (5 refutations), and run `python scripts/test_lean_negative.py`.
3. **Numerical / Physical Attack:** Run `python scripts/run_polyglot_parity.py` to independently compare all 8 engines (including full 32-dim 5-qubit Moonlab WASM and zero-float Zig $\mathbb{Q}$) against the 80-digit Sturm oracle.
4. **Mutation Attack:** Run `python scripts/mutation_audit.py` to verify 10/10 semantic mutants are killed by `tests/test_all.py`.

## Limitations & Epistemic Boundaries (LIMITATIONS.md)

# Limitations, Scope Boundaries, and Epistemic Honesty

## 1. Formal Proof Boundary vs. Computational & Empirical Scope

- **Machine-Checked in Lean 4.35.0 (`[LEAN-6K]`):** Theorems 1–10 (all 12 isolated targets in `lean/Challenge.lean`, 18 non-vacuity witnesses, and 5 adversarial refutations; **572 audited theorem constants** strictly within `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]`, zero Batteries `runLinter` errors, and a live `sorry`-tamper negative comparator CI gate).
- **Exact Computational (`[EXACT-COMP]`):** Finite-$M$ critical rupture thresholds for higher Krawtchouk cores $R=4$ ($N=14, M^*=30$) and $R=5$ ($N=17, M^*=78$) are verified by multi-core Rust (`std::thread`), C++20, and SymPy rather than Lean 4 kernel certificates.
- **Empirical (`[EMPIRICAL]`):** The 4-arm QRNG static-disorder robustness study (`PREREGISTRATION.md`, `DEVIATIONS.md`, `results/qgtl_qrng_analysis.json`) is a finite-sample ($K=30$ paired seeds per arm) empirical simulation under uniform static diagonal disorder $\varepsilon \in [0, 0.10]$ scaled by mean hopping $\bar{b}$. It does not prove analytical disorder thresholds for arbitrary noise models (e.g., off-diagonal coupling jitter or time-dependent dephasing).

## 2. Honest Pre-Registered Null Result (Hypothesis H4) & Deviation #1

In the pre-registered QRNG study locked in root commit `1dac632`, Arm H4 tested whether the non-symmetric staggered-field complex ESE chain $J_{1,4}$ maintains a deeper eclipse floor under $\varepsilon = 0.05$ static diagonal disorder than the $5\times 5$ Krawtchouk control. Following the `v1.1.0` optimizer fix documented in `DEVIATIONS.md` (which eliminated boundary trapping at $\varepsilon = 0$ so all four arms evaluate to exact $0.000$ in the clean limit), **H4 remains a clean null result** (`treat_median = 0.01626` vs. `ctrl_median = 0.01377`, `mean_diff = +0.00007`, 95% bootstrap CI `[-0.00619, +0.00689]`, Cohen's $d_z = 0.00$, Cliff's $\delta = -0.078$, $p_{\mathrm{Holm}} = 0.9855$). This reflects genuine topological physics: a complex zero in $\mathbb{C}$ is codimension-2 and lifts linearly as $O(\varepsilon)$ ($\beta \approx 0.83$), whereas real sign changes in symmetric chains (H1–H3, all $p_{\mathrm{Holm}} = 0.0004$) are topologically protected codimension-1 crossings on $\mathbb{R}$.

## 3. Review, Authorship, Conflict of Interest, and Export Control

- **Preprint Status:** This work is an **unrefereed research preprint** (`v1.1.0`). It has not been externally peer-reviewed or submitted to a journal, arXiv, Zenodo, or the Palomar Registry.
- **AI Transparency:** Analytical derivation, Lean 4.35.0 proof engineering, polyglot verification scripts, and manuscript drafting were AI-assisted (Google Gemini / Antigravity) under sole human direction and audit oversight (Alexander S. Donahue, Independent Researcher, ORCID `0009-0006-8168-9648`).
- **Open Human Verification:** Independent human line-by-line review of all 12 Lean files and external independent operator replication (`B44`) remain **OPEN**.
- **Mega-Atlas Boundary:** `0 / 2,000` Mega-Atlas grand problems are retired or claimed (`docs/MEGA_ATLAS_CROSSCHECK.md`). The resolved published conjecture is Conjecture 4.1 of Escobar, Garcia, and Minenkova (`arXiv:2507.18767v1`).
- **Conflict of Interest & Funding:** The author declares no competing financial or non-financial interests; this is self-funded independent research.
- **Export-Control Self-Screen:** This repository contains fundamental mathematical research in spectral theory and linear algebra intended for open scientific dissemination and falls within the fundamental research exclusion of 15 CFR 734.8. It contains no cryptographic primitives, weapons/munitions models, or export-controlled hardware designs.

## 4. Real vs. Metaphor

- **"Spectral Eclipse"** is a descriptive metaphor for the strictly defined mathematical predicate **Early State Exclusion (ESE)**: $\exists \tau \in (0, T_0)$ such that $\langle e_0, e^{-iJt} e_0 \rangle = 0$.
- **"Rupture"** and **"Phase Transition"** denote exact mathematical transitions in the sign of $A_N(t)$ and the asymptotic scaling exponent of the cluster-to-core Hochstadt weight ratio $\Phi(R, r, M) \propto M^{r-R}$ at $r = R+1$; no thermodynamic limit in physical particle number is claimed.
- **Quantum-RNG (`third_party/quantum_rng`)** is a deterministic software CSPRNG/quantum-inspired entropy engine tested against NIST statistical suites, not a live physical optical beam-splitter hardware device.

## Pre-Registration Protocol (PREREGISTRATION.md)

# Pre-Registration: Seeded QRNG Diagonal-Disorder Robustness of Early State Exclusion

- **Document status:** Locked prior to running the disorder Monte Carlo experiment (Build Standard v1.2.0 item B32).
- **Author:** Alexander S. Donahue (ORCID `0009-0006-8168-9648`, Independent Researcher, Spokane, WA, USA)
- **Date locked:** 2026-11-26 (committed to `main` before any `engines/qgtl_qrng` experiment code is compiled or executed).
- **Epistemic tag:** `[NUM-APPROX]` (experimental statistical robustness study; completely separate from our exact `[LEAN-6K]` theorems).

## 1. Research Question

Exact Early State Exclusion (ESE) is an exact zero $\mathcal{A}(\tau) = \langle e^{-i J \tau} \mathbf{e}_0, \mathbf{e}_0 \rangle = 0$ at an interior time $\tau \in (0, T_0)$ for an ideal persymmetric Jacobi spin chain $J$. Under realistic fabrication noise (zero-mean random static on-site diagonal disorder $J_\varepsilon = J + \varepsilon \operatorname{diag}(\xi_0, \dots, \xi_{N-1})$ with $\xi_k \sim \mathrm{Uniform}(-1, 1)$ drawn from the vendored Tsotchke Quantum-RNG stream `third_party/quantum_rng/`), exact zeros lift into nonzero return-probability minima
$$m(J_\varepsilon) := \min_{t \in [0.05 T_0, 0.95 T_0]} \left| \langle e^{-i J_\varepsilon t} \mathbf{e}_0, \mathbf{e}_0 \rangle \right|.$$
We test whether genuine **rupture / staggered ESE chains** retain strictly deeper interior amplitude eclipses under diagonal disorder than **no-ESE control chains** of identical or matched dimension and identical spectral bandwidth normalization.

## 2. Primary Endpoints & Arms (Fixed Before Execution)

Every chain is normalized by its Frobenius spectral radius scale so the perturbation ratio $\varepsilon \in \{0.00, 0.01, 0.02, 0.05, 0.10\}$ is dimensionless relative to the chain's average hopping strength $\bar{b} = \frac{1}{N-1}\sum_{k=0}^{N-2} b_k$.

Four pre-specified comparisons (paired on identical QRNG seed $s \in \{1, 2, \dots, 30\}$, with $N_{\mathrm{seeds}} = 30$ independent paired replicates per disorder level $\varepsilon$, using 500-point interior grid refined by golden-section search):

1. **H1 (7x7 Conjecture 4.1 Dichotomy — Rupture vs. Control, $N = 7$):**
   - *Treatment (ESE):* $7\times 7$ coprime chain $\{0, \pm 3, \pm 4, \pm 5\}$ (minimal odd coprime ESE witness, $\lambda_1 = 3 \nmid 4, 5$).
   - *Control (No ESE):* $7\times 7$ divisibility chain $\{0, \pm 1, \pm 2, \pm 5\}$ ($\lambda_1 = 1$, proven no ESE by Theorem 4).
   - *Directional hypothesis:* At $\varepsilon = 0.05$, median $m_{\mathrm{treat}} < m_{\mathrm{ctrl}}$ (strictly deeper return-amplitude minimum).
2. **H2 (8x8 Sharp Even Rupture vs. 6x6 Even Critical Control):**
   - *Treatment (ESE):* $8\times 8$ minimal even rupture chain $\{\pm\frac{1}{2}, \pm\frac{7}{2}, \pm\frac{9}{2}, \pm\frac{11}{2}\}$ ($p_1 = 1$, Theorem 5).
   - *Control (No ESE):* $6\times 6$ even critical chain $\{\pm\frac{1}{2}, \pm\frac{5}{2}, \pm\frac{7}{2}\}$ ($p_1 = 1$, Theorem 3).
   - *Directional hypothesis:* At $\varepsilon = 0.05$, median $m_{\mathrm{treat}} < m_{\mathrm{ctrl}}$.
3. **H3 (11x11 Exact Threshold $M^* = 12$ — Supercritical $m=6$ vs. Subcritical $m=5$):**
   - *Treatment (ESE):* $11\times 11$ supercritical chain $\{0, \pm 1, \pm 12, \pm 13, \pm 14, \pm 15\}$ ($m = 6$, Theorem 7).
   - *Control (No ESE):* $11\times 11$ subcritical chain $\{0, \pm 1, \pm 10, \pm 11, \pm 12, \pm 13\}$ ($m = 5$, Theorem 7).
   - *Directional hypothesis:* At $\varepsilon = 0.05$, median $m_{\mathrm{treat}} < m_{\mathrm{ctrl}}$.
4. **H4 (5x5 Staggered Non-Symmetric Complex ESE $J_{1,4}$ vs. 5x5 Krawtchouk Control):**
   - *Treatment (Complex ESE):* $5\times 5$ staggered non-symmetric chain $J_{1,4}$ with spectrum $\{0, 1, 4, 9, 10\}$ (Theorem 9, exact complex eclipse at $\tau = \pi/3$).
   - *Control (No ESE):* $5\times 5$ symmetric equidistant Krawtchouk chain $\{0, \pm 1, \pm 2\}$ (Theorem 2, proven no ESE).
   - *Directional hypothesis:* At $\varepsilon = 0.05$, median $m_{\mathrm{treat}} < m_{\mathrm{ctrl}}$.

## 3. Fixed Statistical Analysis Plan

- **Sample size:** $K = 30$ paired QRNG seeds (`seed = 1..30`) per comparison (each seed draws fresh independent disorder vectors via `quantum_rng` SHA-256/ChaCha-mixed deterministic entropy stream).
- **Primary test:** Two-sided exact / $10{,}000$-sign-flip paired permutation test on $d_s = m_{\mathrm{ctrl}}(s) - m_{\mathrm{treat}}(s)$ at $\varepsilon = 0.05$.
- **Multiple-comparison correction:** Holm-Bonferroni across the family of $4$ primary hypotheses ($\alpha_{\mathrm{FWER}} = 0.05$).
- **Effect sizes & uncertainty:** Report median difference, Hodges-Lehmann / mean difference, Cohen's $d_z$ (paired), Cliff's $\delta$, and 10,000-resample percentile bootstrap 95% confidence intervals.
- **No p-hacking / stopping rules:** All 4 comparisons and all 5 disorder levels $\varepsilon \in \{0.00, 0.01, 0.02, 0.05, 0.10\}$ will be reported in full regardless of outcome, including any null or reversed effects.
- **Secondary exploratory metric (labeled exploratory):** Return-probability scaling $m(\varepsilon) \propto \varepsilon^\beta$ and QGTL speed-limit ratio $\eta(\varepsilon) = \frac{\pi}{2 b_0 \tau_{\min}(\varepsilon)}$.

## Deviation #1 (`v1.1.0`, 2026-11-27): Numerical Optimizer Bug Fix in `compute_interior_min` (Endpoint Unchanged)

- **Category:** Numerical implementation bug fix (ZERO change to hypotheses H1–H4, chains, disorder levels $\varepsilon \in \{0.00, 0.01, 0.02, 0.05, 0.10\}$, $K = 30$ paired QRNG seeds, primary window $[0.05\,T_0, 0.95\,T_0]$, permutation test, or Holm–Bonferroni $\alpha = 0.05$ FWER control).
- **Bug Discovered During Cycle 2 Hardening:** In `v1.0.0`, `compute_interior_min` (`engines/qgtl_qrng/se_qgtl_qrng.c`) evaluated $|A(t)|$ on a 500-point uniform grid over $[0.05\,T_0, 0.95\,T_0]$ and ran 50-step golden-section refinement **only around the single lowest grid sample**. Because PST chains satisfy $|A(t)| = O((\pi - t)^{N-1})$ near $t = \pi$, the right-boundary sample $t = 0.95\,\pi$ was occasionally smaller than the discrete 500-point grid sample nearest a sharp interior zero $\tau_{\mathrm{ESE}}$ (spacing $\Delta t = 0.90\pi/500 \approx 5.65 \times 10^{-3}$). Consequently, at $\varepsilon = 0$ (ideal zero-disorder baseline), the `v1.0.0` optimizer trapped on the right boundary $t = 0.95\pi$ and reported $m(J_{1,4}, \varepsilon = 0) = 1.655 \times 10^{-3}$ instead of the exact mathematical value $m(J_{1,4}, 0) = |A(\pi/3)| = 0$.
- **Fix Applied (`v1.1.0`):** `compute_interior_min` still evaluates the exact same 500-point grid on $[0.05\,T_0, 0.95\,T_0]$, but now runs 50-step golden-section refinement on **every local-minimum bracket** ($v_i \le v_{i-1}$ and $v_i \le v_{i+1}$, plus endpoints) and takes the true global minimum over $[0.05\,T_0, 0.95\,T_0]$.
- **Impact Comparison (`v1.0.0` Single-Bracket vs. `v1.1.0` All-Local-Minima-Refined):**

| Arm | Metric | `v1.0.0` (Single-Bracket) | `v1.1.0` (All-Local-Minima Fixed) | Qualitative Verdict Changed? |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| **H1** ($7\times 7$) | $\varepsilon = 0$ treat min | $8.036 \times 10^{-6}$ | **$0.000 \times 10^{0}$** | Fixed artifact |
| **H1** ($7\times 7$) | $\varepsilon = 0.05$ treat / ctrl med, $d_z$, $\delta$, $p_{\mathrm{Holm}}$ | $0.00233$ / $0.01539$, $+0.91$, $+0.542$, $0.0004$ | $0.00233$ / $0.01539$, $+0.91$, $+0.542$, **$0.0004$** | **No** (SIG) |
| **H2** ($8\times 8$ vs $6\times 6$) | $\varepsilon = 0$ treat min | $7.442 \times 10^{-7}$ | **$0.000 \times 10^{0}$** | Fixed artifact |
| **H2** ($8\times 8$ vs $6\times 6$) | $\varepsilon = 0.05$ treat / ctrl med, $d_z$, $\delta$, $p_{\mathrm{Holm}}$ | $0.00347$ / $0.10373$, $+14.99$, $+1.000$, $0.0004$ | $0.00347$ / $0.10373$, $+14.68$, $+1.000$, **$0.0004$** | **No** (SIG) |
| **H3** ($11\times 11$ $m=6$ vs $5$) | $\varepsilon = 0$ treat min | $5.391 \times 10^{-7}$ | **$0.000 \times 10^{0}$** | Fixed artifact |
| **H3** ($11\times 11$ $m=6$ vs $5$) | $\varepsilon = 0.05$ treat / ctrl med, $d_z$, $\delta$, $p_{\mathrm{Holm}}$ | $0.00752$ / $0.00995$, $+0.75$, $+0.238$, $0.0008$ | $0.00685$ / $0.00995$, $+0.83$, $+0.247$, **$0.0004$** | **No** (SIG, stronger) |
| **H4** ($5\times 5$ $J_{1,4}$ vs Kraw.) | $\varepsilon = 0$ treat min | $1.655 \times 10^{-3}$ | **$0.000 \times 10^{0}$** | Fixed artifact |
| **H4** ($5\times 5$ $J_{1,4}$ vs Kraw.) | $\varepsilon = 0.05$ treat / ctrl med, $d_z$, $\delta$, $p_{\mathrm{Holm}}$ | $0.01626$ / $0.01377$, $+0.00$, $-0.078$, $0.9880$ | $0.01626$ / $0.01377$, $+0.00$, $-0.078$, **$0.9855$** | **No** (Honest NULL) |

- **Conclusion:** Fixing the optimizer bug eliminates all four $\varepsilon = 0$ discretization artifacts cleanly without altering a single pre-registered hypothesis decision (H1–H3 remain strongly significant at $p_{\mathrm{Holm}} = 0.0004$; H4 remains a clean pre-registered null at $p_{\mathrm{Holm}} = 0.9855$).

## Replication Protocol (REPLICATION.md)

# Replication Guide

This document provides exact, clean-room, step-by-step instructions to independently reproduce every Lean 4.35.0 proof, all eight polyglot and quantum engines, the pre-registered QRNG study, all five publication figures, the frozen AMS-LaTeX PDF, the standalone arXiv tarball, and cryptographic integrity checks (`v1.1.0`).

## Prerequisites

- **Lean 4.35.0:** Installed via `elan` (`lean/lean-toolchain` pins `leanprover/lean4:v4.35.0`; `lean/lake-manifest.json` pins Mathlib `v4.35.0`).
- **Python 3.9–3.12:** (`requirements.txt` pins CVE-free Python 3.12 wheels used on CI; editable install via `pip install --no-deps -e .`).
- **Polyglot Toolchains (for full 8-engine parity):** `gcc` / `g++` (C11 & C++20), `nasm` (optional x86-64 AVX2 assembly; automatic scalar C11 fallback if absent), `rustc` / `cargo`, `zig` (0.17.0+), `node` (v18+ for Moonlab WASM), `eshkol-run` (optional; automatic Python dual-number fallback if absent).
- **LaTeX:** `tectonic` (v0.15+) for reproducible PDF and arXiv tarball compilation.
- **Timestamp verification:** `openssl` (for DigiCert RFC 3161 `.tsr` verification).

## Step 1: Machine-Checked Lean 4.35.0 Verification & 6-Checker Palomar Replay

```bash
cd lean
lake exe cache get
lake build SpectralEclipse Challenge Solution VerifyAxioms
lake env lean VerifyAxioms.lean
lake exe runLinter SpectralEclipse Solution
# On Linux with bubblewrap installed (exact CI command):
lake comparator --config comparator.json --paranoid
cd ..
python scripts/test_lean_negative.py
python scripts/check_readme_axioms.py --require-exhaustive
```

Expected sentinel:
`ALL_THEOREMS_AXIOM_AUDIT_PASS: checked 572 theorems across SpectralEclipse — 0 disallowed axioms.`

## Step 2: Python Verification Ladder & B13 Mutation Audit

```bash
python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
python -m pip install --no-deps -e .
python -m pytest -v tests/
python reference/exact_oracle.py
python scripts/mutation_audit.py
ruff check python reference scripts tests
mypy --strict --explicit-package-bases --ignore-missing-imports python reference scripts tests
```

Expected: `22 passed` (including 1,000-case Hypothesis metamorphic suite, single-version consistency, `repo.yaml` schema validation, link integrity, and manifest tamper rejection), `10/10` mutants killed (`100.0%`), `0` ruff errors, `0` mypy errors.

## Step 3: Build & Cross-Verify All 8 Polyglot & Quantum Engines

```bash
# 1. NASM AVX2+FMA Assembly + ISO C11
make -C engines/c clean all && ./engines/c/test_c_core

# 2. ISO C++20 direct matrix-exponential propagator
make -C engines/cpp clean all && ./engines/cpp/se_propagator

# 3. Safe Rust multi-core scanner
cd engines/rust && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --release && cargo run --release && cd ../..

# 4. Zig 0.17.0 exact arbitrary-precision rational Hochstadt engine
cd engines/zig && zig run -OReleaseSafe src/main.zig && cd ../..

# 5. Eshkol v1.3.6 native AD (or pure-Python dual fallback)
python engines/eshkol/run_eshkol.py

# 6. Moonlab WASM 5-qubit (32-dim) many-body XY+Z simulator
node engines/moonlab/moonlab_xy_sim.cjs

# 7. Vendored QGTL + Quantum-RNG study & statistical analysis
make -C engines/qgtl_qrng clean all && ./engines/qgtl_qrng/se_qgtl_qrng
python scripts/analyze_qrng_study.py

# 8. Automated 8-engine cross-parity report (0 mismatches)
python scripts/run_polyglot_parity.py
```

## Step 4: Figures, Paper, Standalone arXiv Tarball, Web Portal & Integrity Checks

```bash
python scripts/check_citations.py
python scripts/generate_figures.py
python scripts/package_arxiv.py
python scripts/generate_llms_full.py
python scripts/build_blueprint.py
python scripts/build_site.py
python scripts/generate_manifest.py --verify
python scripts/stamp_timestamps.py --verify
```
